sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM customers
SELECT COUNT(*) AS sellers FROM sellers
SELECT COUNT(*) AS canceled_orders FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'canceled'

SELECT order_status, COUNT(*) AS orders
FROM orders
GROUP BY order_status
ORDER BY orders DESC

SELECT MIN(order_purchase_timestamp) AS first_order,
       MAX(order_purchase_timestamp) AS last_order
FROM orders
SELECT COUNT(*) AS products_without_category FROM products WHERE product_category_name IS NULL
SELECT ROUND(AVG(review_score), 2) AS avg_review_score FROM reviews

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE review_score = 5) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_five_star
FROM reviews

SELECT payment_type
FROM payments
GROUP BY payment_type
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(AVG(payment_installments), 2) AS avg_installments
FROM payments
WHERE payment_type = 'credit_card'
SELECT MAX(payment_installments) AS max_installments FROM payments

SELECT customer_state
FROM customers
GROUP BY customer_state
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, seller_state AS st, 'x' AS extra FROM sellers GROUP BY st ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT ROUND(AVG(product_weight_g), 2) AS avg_weight_g FROM products

SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders_2017
FROM orders
WHERE year(order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017
SELECT ROUND(AVG(price), 2) AS avg_item_price FROM order_items
SELECT MAX(price) AS max_item_price FROM order_items

SELECT COUNT(*) AS reviews_with_comment
FROM reviews
WHERE review_comment_message IS NOT NULL
  AND trim(review_comment_message) <> ''

SELECT COUNT(*) AS late_orders
FROM orders
WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
  AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
  AND CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) > CAST(order_estimated_delivery_date AS DATE)
SELECT SUM(price+freight_value) FROM order_items

SELECT year(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS year, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o USING (order_id)
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND year(o.order_purchase_timestamp) IN (2017, 2018)
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY year

SELECT COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS category,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o USING (order_id)
JOIN products p USING (product_id)
LEFT JOIN category_translation t USING (product_category_name)
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS category,
       COUNT(*) AS items_sold
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p USING (product_id)
LEFT JOIN category_translation t USING (product_category_name)
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY items_sold DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT ROUND(AVG((epoch(order_delivered_customer_date) - epoch(order_purchase_timestamp)) / 86400.0), 2) AS avg_delivery_days
FROM orders
WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL

SELECT c.customer_state,
       ROUND(AVG((epoch(o.order_delivered_customer_date) - epoch(o.order_purchase_timestamp)) / 86400.0), 2) AS avg_delivery_days
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c USING (customer_id)
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.customer_state
ORDER BY avg_delivery_days DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (
         WHERE CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) > CAST(order_estimated_delivery_date AS DATE)
       ) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_late
FROM orders
WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL

SELECT AVG(sc) a, late FROM (SELECT o.order_id, CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) > CAST(order_estimated_delivery_date AS DATE) late, AVG(review_score) sc FROM orders o JOIN reviews r USING(order_id) WHERE order_status='delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1,2) GROUP BY late

SELECT month(order_purchase_timestamp) AS month, COUNT(*) AS orders
FROM orders
WHERE year(order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month

SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.price) / COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id), 2) AS avg_order_value
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o USING (order_id)
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')

SELECT oi.seller_id, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o USING (order_id)
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY oi.seller_id
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT COUNT(*) AS sellers
FROM (SELECT seller_id FROM order_items GROUP BY seller_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 100)

SELECT c.customer_state
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o USING (order_id)
JOIN customers c USING (customer_id)
GROUP BY c.customer_state
ORDER BY AVG(oi.freight_value) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS multi_item_orders
FROM (SELECT order_id FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE n_types > 1) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_multi_type
FROM (SELECT order_id, COUNT(DISTINCT payment_type) AS n_types FROM payments GROUP BY order_id)

SELECT payment_type, ROUND(SUM(payment_value), 2) AS total_paid
FROM payments
GROUP BY payment_type
ORDER BY total_paid DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM orders GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)

SELECT c.customer_city
FROM orders o JOIN customers c USING (customer_id)
GROUP BY c.customer_city
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_category_name) AS categories
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o USING (order_id)
JOIN products p USING (product_id)
WHERE year(o.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2018
  AND p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL

SELECT ROUND(AVG(p.product_photos_qty), 2) AS avg_photos
FROM products p
JOIN category_translation t USING (product_category_name)
WHERE t.product_category_name_english = 'health_beauty'

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE has_boleto) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_boleto
FROM (SELECT order_id, bool_or(payment_type = 'boleto') AS has_boleto FROM payments GROUP BY order_id)

SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o USING (order_id)
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-11-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2017-12-01'

SELECT dayname(order_purchase_timestamp) AS weekday
FROM orders
GROUP BY weekday
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT hour(order_purchase_timestamp) AS hour
FROM orders
GROUP BY hour
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH order_scores AS (
  SELECT order_id, AVG(review_score) AS score FROM reviews GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.score), 2) AS avg_review_score
FROM order_scores s
JOIN orders o USING (order_id)
JOIN customers c USING (customer_id)
WHERE c.customer_state = 'SP'

WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month, SUM(oi.price) AS revenue
  FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o USING (order_id)
  WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-12-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-09-01'
  GROUP BY month
)
SELECT strftime(month, '%Y-%m') AS month,
       ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue,
       ROUND(100.0 * (revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month)) / LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month), 2) AS mom_growth_pct
FROM monthly
QUALIFY month >= '2018-01-01'
ORDER BY month

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE n_orders > 1) / COUNT(*), 2) AS repeat_rate_pct
FROM (
  SELECT c.customer_unique_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS n_orders
  FROM orders o JOIN customers c USING (customer_id)
  GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
)

WITH cat AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS category, SUM(oi.price) AS revenue
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN orders o USING (order_id)
  JOIN products p USING (product_id)
  LEFT JOIN category_translation t USING (product_category_name)
  WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  GROUP BY category
)
SELECT category, ROUND(100.0 * revenue / SUM(revenue) OVER (), 2) AS pct_of_revenue
FROM cat
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 5

WITH cat_year AS (
  SELECT year(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS year,
         COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS category,
         SUM(oi.price) AS revenue
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN orders o USING (order_id)
  JOIN products p USING (product_id)
  LEFT JOIN category_translation t USING (product_category_name)
  WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
    AND year(o.order_purchase_timestamp) IN (2017, 2018)
  GROUP BY year, category
)
SELECT year, category, ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue
FROM cat_year
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY revenue DESC) <= 3
ORDER BY year, revenue DESC

WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT month(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month, SUM(oi.price) AS revenue
  FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o USING (order_id)
  WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
    AND year(o.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017
  GROUP BY month
)
SELECT month, ROUND(SUM(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month), 2) AS cumulative_revenue
FROM monthly
ORDER BY month

WITH order_scores AS (
  SELECT order_id, AVG(review_score) AS score FROM reviews GROUP BY order_id
),
seller_orders AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT seller_id, order_id FROM order_items
)
SELECT so.seller_id, ROUND(AVG(s.score), 2) AS avg_review_score, COUNT(*) AS reviewed_orders
FROM seller_orders so
JOIN order_scores s USING (order_id)
GROUP BY so.seller_id
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50
ORDER BY AVG(s.score), so.seller_id
LIMIT 5

WITH order_scores AS (
  SELECT order_id, AVG(review_score) AS score FROM reviews GROUP BY order_id
),
d AS (
  SELECT o.order_id,
         date_diff('day', CAST(o.order_estimated_delivery_date AS DATE), CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE)) AS days_late
  FROM orders o
  WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT CASE WHEN days_late < 0 THEN '1 early'
            WHEN days_late = 0 THEN '2 same day'
            WHEN days_late <= 3 THEN '3 1-3 days late'
            WHEN days_late <= 7 THEN '4 4-7 days late'
            ELSE '5 >7 days late' END AS bucket,
       ROUND(AVG(s.score), 2) AS avg_review_score,
       COUNT(*) AS orders
FROM d JOIN order_scores s USING (order_id)
GROUP BY bucket
ORDER BY bucket

SELECT c.customer_state,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (
         WHERE CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) > CAST(o.order_estimated_delivery_date AS DATE)
       ) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_late
FROM orders o JOIN customers c USING (customer_id)
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.customer_state
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 500
ORDER BY pct_late DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT c.customer_unique_id, o.order_purchase_timestamp AS ts,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.customer_unique_id ORDER BY o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS rn
  FROM orders o JOIN customers c USING (customer_id)
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG((epoch(second.ts) - epoch(first.ts)) / 86400.0), 2) AS avg_days_to_second_order
FROM ranked first
JOIN ranked second
  ON first.customer_unique_id = second.customer_unique_id AND first.rn = 1 AND second.rn = 2

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(oi.price) FILTER (WHERE s.seller_state = c.customer_state) / SUM(oi.price), 2) AS pct_same_state
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o USING (order_id)
JOIN customers c USING (customer_id)
JOIN sellers s USING (seller_id)
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')

SELECT c.customer_state,
       ROUND(MEDIAN((epoch(o.order_delivered_customer_date) - epoch(o.order_purchase_timestamp)) / 86400.0), 2) AS median_delivery_days
FROM orders o JOIN customers c USING (customer_id)
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.customer_state
ORDER BY median_delivery_days
LIMIT 5

SELECT COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS category
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p USING (product_id)
LEFT JOIN category_translation t USING (product_category_name)
WHERE oi.price > 0
GROUP BY category
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000
ORDER BY AVG(oi.freight_value / oi.price) DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH cust_orders AS (
  SELECT c.customer_unique_id, o.order_purchase_timestamp AS ts
  FROM orders o JOIN customers c USING (customer_id)
),
firsts AS (
  SELECT customer_unique_id, MIN(ts) AS first_ts FROM cust_orders GROUP BY customer_unique_id
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.customer_unique_id) AS returned_within_90_days
FROM firsts f
JOIN cust_orders co
  ON co.customer_unique_id = f.customer_unique_id
 AND co.ts > f.first_ts
 AND co.ts <= f.first_ts + INTERVAL 90 DAY
WHERE f.first_ts >= '2018-01-01' AND f.first_ts < '2018-02-01'

SELECT CASE WHEN payment_installments <= 1 THEN '1 single'
            WHEN payment_installments <= 6 THEN '2 2-6'
            ELSE '3 7+' END AS installment_bucket,
       ROUND(AVG(payment_value), 2) AS avg_payment_value
FROM payments
WHERE payment_type = 'credit_card'
GROUP BY installment_bucket
ORDER BY installment_bucket

WITH order_scores AS (
  SELECT order_id, AVG(review_score) AS score FROM reviews GROUP BY order_id
),
order_cats AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT oi.order_id, COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS category
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN products p USING (product_id)
  LEFT JOIN category_translation t USING (product_category_name)
  WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT oc.category, ROUND(AVG(s.score), 2) AS avg_review_score
FROM order_cats oc JOIN order_scores s USING (order_id)
GROUP BY oc.category
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 500
ORDER BY AVG(s.score) DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT month(order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (
         WHERE CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) > CAST(order_estimated_delivery_date AS DATE)
       ) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_late
FROM orders
WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
  AND order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-09-01'
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month

SELECT oi.seller_id
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o USING (order_id)
JOIN customers c USING (customer_id)
GROUP BY oi.seller_id
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT c.customer_state,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.price) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id), 2) AS revenue_per_customer
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o USING (order_id)
JOIN customers c USING (customer_id)
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY c.customer_state
ORDER BY revenue_per_customer DESC
LIMIT 5

WITH so AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT oi.order_id, s.seller_state
  FROM order_items oi JOIN sellers s USING (seller_id)
)
SELECT so.seller_state,
       ROUND(AVG((epoch(o.order_delivered_carrier_date) - epoch(o.order_approved_at)) / 86400.0), 2) AS avg_days_to_carrier
FROM so JOIN orders o USING (order_id)
WHERE o.order_approved_at IS NOT NULL AND o.order_delivered_carrier_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY so.seller_state
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000
ORDER BY avg_days_to_carrier DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT COUNT(*) AS products FROM (
  SELECT oi.product_id FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o USING (order_id)
  WHERE year(o.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017
  EXCEPT
  SELECT oi.product_id FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o USING (order_id)
  WHERE year(o.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2018
)

WITH items AS (
  SELECT order_id, SUM(price + freight_value) AS items_total FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id
),
pays AS (
  SELECT order_id, SUM(payment_value) AS paid FROM payments GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS mismatched_orders
FROM items JOIN pays USING (order_id)
WHERE abs(items.items_total - pays.paid) > 1

SELECT CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE) AS day, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o USING (order_id)
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY day
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT 1 FROM nonexistent

WITH d AS (
  SELECT o.order_id,
         date_diff('day', CAST(o.order_estimated_delivery_date AS DATE), CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE)) AS days_late
  FROM orders o
  WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT CASE WHEN days_late > 7 THEN 'more_than_7_days_late' ELSE 'on_time_or_early' END AS grp,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.review_score = 1) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_one_star
FROM d JOIN reviews r USING (order_id)
WHERE days_late > 7 OR days_late <= 0
GROUP BY grp
ORDER BY grp

SELECT COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS category,
       COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) AS customers
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o USING (order_id)
JOIN customers c USING (customer_id)
JOIN products p USING (product_id)
LEFT JOIN category_translation t USING (product_category_name)
WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY customers DESC
LIMIT 5
